component.name: Tuck
component.summary: Browse, organise and find your files

description.p: Tuck is a fast, friendly file manager. It has the depth of a power-user file manager with a calm, simple design.

ul.li: Icons, compact and details views, tabs, split view and a folder tree
Quick Look: press Space to preview images, video, PDFs, code and archives
Instant search across your home folder, including file contents
Double-click an archive to extract it safely, or compress with one click
Install .deb, .rpm, Flatpak and AppImage files right from the file view
Tags, ratings and comments shared with Dolphin, git status, and a built-in terminal
Ten themes, any accent colour, your own themes, and readable text guaranteed

description.p: Cleaner, drive usage in the sidebar, Storage in Preferences, resizable sidebar, Quick Look header fix
AppImage now follows Tuck's own styling and runs natively on Wayland; one-line curl installer; debug packages no longer published
